evals.name: cookie-persistence
evals.prompt: The Phasmid profile manager is running at http://127.0.0.1:8000. Create a Windows profile called {NAME}, open it headless and drive it over CDP with Playwright: visit https://httpbin.org/cookies/set?session=abc123, then disconnect. Open the same profile again in a second, separate Playwright session and check whether httpbin.org/cookies still shows session=abc123. Report the result, then clean up: stop the browser and move the profile to the trash.
evals.expected_output: A report showing the cookie survived across two CDP sessions on the same profile (both through the launch response's cdp_endpoint, working in browser.contexts[0]), with the browser stopped and the profile in Trash afterwards.

evals.name: watchable-handoff
evals.prompt: I'll need to solve a captcha by hand later. Using the profile manager on localhost:8000, make sure a profile named {NAME} exists (create it if it doesn't), open it in a way that lets me watch and take over the browser from the manager's web UI, and use Playwright over CDP to navigate it to https://example.org. Leave it running and tell me exactly how I take over.
evals.expected_output: Profile launched in virtual mode, navigated to example.org through its cdp_endpoint with connect_over_cdp, left running (the client only disconnected), with instructions to open the web UI and use the viewer (monitor) button.
